summary: Accepted after final independent review. The EC covers the delayed-task stability claim through concrete behavior, efficiency, live-soak, and operator/PVC recovery cases. The executable oracles require non-zero work, exact numeric thresholds, durable state transitions, repeated Raft failover, an exact Bound 1Gi PVC request and reported capacity, post-replacement mutations, and fail-closed Kind cleanup with cluster absence verification. Empty, skipped, partial, or degenerate implementations cannot satisfy the combined gates.
